topics.title: Binary & Hexadecimal
topics.description: Bit-level fluency: binary/hex/decimal conversion, subnet masks as binary, reading hex dumps. Every subnetting question is binary arithmetic in disguise.

topics.title: Boolean Algebra & Logic
topics.description: AND/OR/NOT/XOR, truth tables, De Morgan's laws — the logic inside subnet masks, firewall rules, and PowerShell -and/-or/-not.

topics.title: Subnetting & CIDR
topics.description: Network/broadcast/first-usable, host counts, VLSM sizing, supernetting. The single most-interviewed math skill in infrastructure roles.

topics.title: Modular Arithmetic
topics.description: Clock arithmetic: hashing buckets, RAID striping math, port-number wrapping, scheduling rotations. mod is everywhere in systems.

topics.title: Set Theory
topics.description: Unions, intersections, complements applied to AD group membership, firewall rule overlap, and allow/deny list reasoning.

topics.title: Reliability & Statistics
topics.description: MTBF/MTTR, availability percentages ('nines'), RAID failure math, reading monitoring percentiles (p50/p95/p99) without panicking.

knowledgeCheck.q: What is binary 11010110 in decimal?
What is hex 0xFF in decimal?
How many bits are set (1s) in binary 10110100?
knowledgeCheck.explain: Positions: 1,0,1,1,0,1,0,0 -> four 1s.

knowledgeCheck.q: What is 0xC0 in binary?
NOT (A AND B) is equivalent to?
knowledgeCheck.explain: De Morgan's law: NOT(A AND B) = (NOT A) OR (NOT B).

knowledgeCheck.q: A XOR A equals?
knowledgeCheck.explain: Anything XOR itself cancels to 0.

knowledgeCheck.q: In PowerShell, -not ($a -and $b) with $a=$true,$b=$false evaluates to?
knowledgeCheck.explain: $true -and $false = $false; -not $false = $true.

knowledgeCheck.q: How many usable hosts in a /28?
Network address of 10.20.30.200/26?
knowledgeCheck.explain: /26 blocks of 64: 200 is in 192-255.

knowledgeCheck.q: Which mask gives at least 100 usable hosts?
knowledgeCheck.explain: /25 = 126 usable; /26 = only 62. Round up.

knowledgeCheck.q: A cron job runs every 6 hours starting at hour 2. At which hours does it run?
Group A has 40 users, Group B has 30, 10 are in both. How many unique users?

knowledgeCheck.explain: 100 - 20 = 80 (the 5 overlapping were in the allow set and are now denied).

knowledgeCheck.q: A service is up 99.9% ('three nines'). Approx yearly downtime?
knowledgeCheck.explain: 0.1% of 8760 hours = 8.76 hours.

knowledgeCheck.q: MTBF 1000h, MTTR 4h. Availability?
p99 latency 800ms means?
knowledgeCheck.explain: p99 is the 99th percentile: 99% at or below, 1% above.

knowledgeCheck.q: RAID 1 with 2x 4TB disks gives usable?
knowledgeCheck.explain: Mirroring: usable = size of one disk.

binary-hex.q: What is the binary of subnet mask 255.255.255.192?

solutionSteps: Consensus/absorption: = B AND (A OR NOT A)... expand: = (A AND NOT A) OR B = 0 OR B = B

generators.template: Given {ip}/{cidr}: network address? broadcast? usable host count?
generators.solver: Block size = 2^(32-cidr); network = floor(ip/block)*block in the interesting octet; broadcast = network+block-1; usable = block-2.

generators.template: Smallest subnet (CIDR) fitting at least {hosts} hosts?
generators.solver: Find smallest host-bits h with 2^h - 2 >= hosts; CIDR = 32 - h.

generators.template: A rotation has {n} slots starting at slot {s}. Which slot is used on occurrence {k}?
|A|={a}, |B|={b}, |A intersect B|={i}. |A union B|? Complement vs universe {u}?
generators.solver: Union = a + b - i; neither = u - union.

masteryModel.recheckPolicy: After reaching proficient, the engine re-checks with 3 spaced questions per topic at 24h and 7d intervals; a miss drops the topic one level and queues remedial exercises.
masteryModel.promotionRule: Promote a topic when the learner answers 8 consecutive mixed questions correctly (knowledge-check + generated), with at least 2 from the generator pool.
masteryModel.infinitePractice: Generators produce unbounded parameterized variants; the engine never repeats an exact question within a session and tracks per-template accuracy to target weak templates.

masteryMap.spec: A per-learner JSON map: {topicId: {level, correctStreak, attempts, weakTemplates[], lastRecheck}}. The shell renders it as a 6-cell heat grid; cells glow as topics approach mastery. The assembler persists this map (see progressPersistence) and the engine reads it on every launch to pick the next question adaptively (weakest topic first, 70/30 weak/strong mix).

progressPersistence.syncNote: Local-first; export/import JSON for backup. No server account required.

masteryModel.recheckPolicy: Proficient topics re-check with 3 spaced questions at 24h and 7d; a miss drops one level and queues remedial exercises. Mastery requires writing (not just recognizing) 5 generated solutions judged by the solution-steps rubric.
masteryModel.promotionRule: 8 consecutive correct mixed answers (2+ from generators) promotes a topic; scripting-constructs additionally requires one full written solution per promotion.
masteryModel.infinitePractice: Generators emit unbounded parameterized variants; the engine tracks per-template accuracy and biases toward weak templates (70/30 weak/strong mix), never repeating an exact question in a session.
masteryModel.masteryGating: Topics unlock in dependency order: cmdlets -> pipeline -> log-parsing -> scripting-constructs; ad-management requires cmdlets+pipeline at developing; services and network-diag require pipeline at developing. Locked topics show prerequisites, not questions.

masteryMap.spec: Per-learner JSON: {topicId: {level, correctStreak, attempts, weakTemplates[], writtenSolutions, lastRecheck, locked}}. Rendered as a 7-node dependency graph; nodes fill as levels rise, locked nodes greyed with prerequisite labels. The engine selects next question from the weakest unlocked topic.
